tests.procedure: Under strong white light, check each received sample container separately in a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour conformance and compliance with the visual specification.

details.vessel: clean transparent watch glass or glass dish

tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg powdered sample in a stoppered tube, add solvent stepwise (0.1 mL, then +0.9 mL, +2 mL, +7 mL), shaking vigorously 1 min and holding at 25.0 +/- 0.5 C for 15 min after each addition (repeat shake/hold once if not dissolved); classify by the volume at which it dissolves. If still undissolved, 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble), then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble. Repeat with methanol and hexane.

solvents: Water (implied, spec: slightly soluble in water)
details.sampleStart: 100 mg powdered sample in stoppered tube
details.shakePerStep: 1 min vigorous, then 15 min hold; repeat once if not dissolved
details.reference: BP 2024 (SC IV K.) Characters Section in Monographs (Hygroscopicity and Solubility)

tests.procedure: IR: mix the sample intimately with potassium bromide and compress into a transparent pellet; examine the spectrum and compare with that of Sildenafil citrate CRS.

details.referenceStandard: Sildenafil citrate CRS (STM:30 also allows Working Standard; spec sheet names WS)
details.reference: BP Appendix II A. Infrared Spectrophotometry

tests.procedure: TLC limit test for impurity E (imidazole). Solvent mixture: concentrated ammonia, water, methanol (5:25:75 V/V/V). Test solution: 35.0 mg in 2.0 mL solvent mixture. Reference (a): 7.0 mg imidazole CRS in solvent mixture to 20.0 mL, then 1.0 mL to 10.0 mL. Reference (b): 5.0 mL of (a) to 10.0 mL. Reference (c): 1 mL test solution + 1 mL reference (a). Apply 10 uL of test solution and references (b) and (c) as 6 mm bands. Mobile phase: concentrated ammonia, ethanol 96%, ethyl acetate, methylene chloride (1:20:30:50). Develop over 2/3 of plate, dry at 100 C ~15 min, expose to iodine vapour until light brown, examine at 254 nm. Rf: citrate ~0, impurity E ~0.25, sildenafil ~0.4. System suitability (ref c): 2 clearly separated zones. Impurity E zone in test solution not more intense than principal zone of reference (b).

details.referenceA: 7.0 mg imidazole CRS (impurity E) in solvent mixture, dilute to 20.0 mL; dilute 1.0 mL to 10.0 mL
details.referenceB: dilute 5.0 mL of reference (a) to 10.0 mL with solvent mixture (the 0.1 % comparison)
details.referenceC: mix 1 mL test solution and 1 mL reference (a)
details.mobilePhase: concentrated ammonia : ethanol 96% : ethyl acetate : methylene chloride 1:20:30:50 V/V/V/V
details.application: 10 uL of test solution and references (b), (c) as bands of 6 mm
details.detection: iodine vapour until plate light brown; UV 254 nm
details.systemSuitability: reference (c): chromatogram shows 2 clearly separated zones
details.acceptance: any zone due to impurity E not more intense than the principal zone with reference (b)
details.reference: BP Appendix III A. Thin-layer Chromatography

tests.procedure: Gradient HPLC related substances, 230 nm, main method (BP, external standard). Test solution (a): 25.0 mg in solvent mixture to 50.0 mL. Reference (c): 1.0 mL test solution (a) to 100.0 mL, then 1.0 mL to 10.0 mL. Reference (a) for system suitability (impurity A), reference (b) for impurity D identification. Result % = (rU/rS) x (CS/CU) x 100 using sildenafil in reference (c); impurity D area x 0.7.

details.bufferSolution: 2.72 g potassium dihydrogen phosphate in 900 mL water, adjust to pH 6.5 with 120 g/L potassium hydroxide solution, dilute to 1.0 L with water
details.solventMixture: acetonitrile for chromatography : mobile phase A (10:90 V/V)
details.testSolutionA: 25.0 mg sample, dissolve in and dilute to 50.0 mL with solvent mixture
details.testSolutionB: 2.0 mL of test solution (a) diluted to 50.0 mL with solvent mixture (defined in STM, not in the injection list)
details.referenceA: 2 mg sildenafil impurity A CRS dissolved in test solution (a), dilute to 10.0 mL with test solution (a); then 1.0 mL to 20.0 mL with solvent mixture
details.referenceB: 5 mg sildenafil for peak identification CRS (contains impurity D) in solvent mixture, dilute to 10.0 mL
details.referenceC: 1.0 mL test solution (a) to 100.0 mL with solvent mixture; then 1.0 mL to 10.0 mL with solvent mixture
details.referenceD: 25.0 mg sildenafil citrate CRS in solvent mixture to 50.0 mL; 2.0 mL to 50.0 mL (defined in STM; not used in the related substances calculation, used in the assay)

column.stationaryPhase: end-capped octadecylsilyl silica gel for chromatography R

details.mobilePhaseB: buffer solution : methanol : acetonitrile for chromatography (20:20:60 V/V/V)
details.injection: 10 uL of test solution (a) and reference solutions (a), (b) and (c)
details.identification: Reference (a) chromatogram identifies impurity A; chromatogram supplied with sildenafil for peak identification CRS and reference (b) identify impurity D
details.systemSuitability: Reference (a): resolution minimum 5.0 between sildenafil and impurity A peaks
details.correctionFactor: multiply the peak area of impurity D by 0.7
details.calculation: Result = (rU/rS) x (CS/CU) x 100; for each impurity use the concentration of sildenafil in reference solution (c); rU = peak response of sildenafil for each impurity of the sample solution, rS = peak response of sildenafil from the standard solution, CS = concentration of the standard solution (mg/mL), CU = concentration of the sample solution (mg/mL)
details.reportingThreshold: 0.05 per cent; disregard the peak due to citrate
details.reference: BP Appendix III D. Liquid Chromatography; BP 2024 Monograph for Sildenafil citrate

tests.procedure: Crucible ignited at 600-650 C and cooled (W0). Weigh accurately 1.0 g sample (W1 = crucible + sample). Moisten with about 1 mL sulfuric acid, char gently on hot plate, cool, moisten residue with sulfuric acid again, heat gently until white fumes cease, ignite in calibrated muffle at 600-650 C, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % Sulphated ash = (W2 - W0) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

details.reference: BP Appendix IX A. Determination of Sulfated Ash

tests.procedure: Karl Fischer water determination on 0.200 g of sample using a calibrated Karl Fischer titrator.

details.reference: BP Appendix IX C. Determination of Water

tests.procedure: Gradient HPLC assay, 230 nm, main method (BP, external standard sildenafil citrate CRS). Test solution (a): 25.0 mg in solvent mixture to 50.0 mL; test solution (b): 2.0 mL of (a) to 50.0 mL. Reference solution (d): 25.0 mg sildenafil citrate CRS in solvent mixture to 50.0 mL; 2.0 mL to 50.0 mL. Result % = (rU/rS) x (CS/CU) x 100, expressed on the anhydrous substance.
